subtitle: 호텔 식당에 저녁 자리 예약하기
desc: 저녁에 호텔 레스토랑에 2인 예약을 잡고 조용한 자리와 채식 메뉴를 확인하는 회화

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Good evening. I'd like to make a dinner reservation for tonight.
turns.ko: 안녕하세요. 오늘 저녁 식사 예약하고 싶어요.

turns.speaker: Host
turns.en: Good evening. Of course. What time would you like, and for how many people?
turns.ko: 안녕하세요. 물론이죠. 몇 시로, 몇 명이요?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Seven thirty, for two people, please.

turns.speaker: Host
turns.en: Let me check. Yes, we have a table at seven thirty. Indoor or outdoor seating?
turns.ko: 확인해 볼게요. 네, 7시 30분에 자리가 있습니다. 실내와 야외 중 어디가 좋으세요?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Indoor, please. It's a bit chilly tonight.
turns.ko: 실내로 부탁해요. 오늘 밤이 좀 쌀쌀하네요.

turns.speaker: Host
turns.en: No problem. May I have your name and a contact number?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: The name is Park. I'm staying in room 412. Could we also get a quiet table?
turns.ko: 이름은 Park이고, 412호에 묵고 있어요. 조용한 자리로 가능할까요?

turns.speaker: Host
turns.en: I'll note that. We can seat you by the window, away from the bar.
turns.ko: 메모해 두겠습니다. 바에서 떨어진 창가 자리로 안내해 드릴게요.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Perfect. Do you have any vegetarian options on the menu?

turns.speaker: Host
turns.en: Yes. We have a mushroom risotto and a roasted vegetable plate. I'll hold the table for fifteen minutes.
turns.ko: 네. 버섯 리조또와 구운 야채 플레이트가 있습니다. 자리는 15분 동안 잡아 둘게요.

tips.en: I'd like to make a dinner reservation for tonight.
What time would you like, and for how many people?
Could we also get a quiet table?
Do you have any vegetarian options on the menu?
